title: OpenClaw VPS Setup & Configuration
summary: Complete documentation of OpenClaw multi-agent AI gateway installed on VPS 180.93.144.98. Includes 4 agents (main/Tony, TD_CTO, TD_PM, Serena_Nguyen) connected via Telegram (4 bots) and Discord (3 bots). Uses CLIProxyAPI on port 8317 as model proxy with 11 models (Gemini 3, Claude, GPT-5.x). Memory system uses Mem0+Qdrant. Version 2026.4.3, config at /root/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Key issues: outdated version, no systemd autostart for gateway, CLIProxyAPI publicly exposed, cron jobs disabled.
